name: Community
tagline: Work that belongs to more than one party — multi-stakeholder coalitions, open-source projects, shared infrastructure.
description: Engagements where there's no single defined client. The work serves a group — a coalition of organisations with competing priorities, an open-source project and the people who rely on it, a network of practitioners, or a public a tool has to answer to. Draftlab's role is to help the collective move forward together, without mistaking any one voice for the whole.
